method: Read actual96runtimeGLBs with exact cell/node transforms and production GroundField height evaluator. Each sharedboundary partitioned at every triangle-edge intersection, including both vertices/midpoints/epsilon-side samples and every affine segment intersection (upper-envelope switch), including nonflat bevel triangles. These partitions cover piecewise-affine height steps. Compare each neighboring detail pair. Auxiliary horizon heights include always-present structural/curb triangles and missing road paint, and are not treated as neighboring-cell seam defects; no generated replacement geometry. Bothqualities use samegeometry.
